questions.question: If the number 4A306768B2 is divisible by both 8 and 11, then the smallest possible values of A and B will be:
questions.questionHtml: If the number 4A306768B2 is divisible by both 8 and 11, then the smallest possible values of A and B will be:
questions.solution:
The given number 4A306768B2 is divisible by 8 and 11 both.

By divisibility rule of 8,

8B2 is divisible by 8

So, B = 3

Now the number becomes:

4A30676832

By divisibility rule of 11,

(4 + 3 + 6 + 6 + 3) - (A + 0 + 7 + 8 + 2) = 0

22 - (A + 17) = 0

22 - A - 17 = 0

5 - A = 0

A = 5

Hence, the values of A and B are 5 and 3 respectively.

Answer: (d) A = 5, B = 3

questions.question: If the equation of a line is 2x - 7y = 14, what is the equation of the line perpendicular to it that passes through the point (4, 1)?
questions.questionHtml: If the equation of a line is 2x - 7y = 14, what is the equation of the line perpendicular to it that passes through the point (4, 1)?
questions.solution:
Given line:

2x - 7y = 14

-7y = -2x + 14

y = 2x/7 - 2

Slope of given line = 2/7

Slope of perpendicular line = -7/2

Using point-slope form:

y - 1 = -7/2(x - 4)

2(y - 1) = -7(x - 4)

2y - 2 = -7x + 28

7x + 2y = 30

questions.question: Two inlets P and Q are connected to a tank. P and Q can fill the tank in 24 hours and 36 hours respectively. If both the pipes, starting with P, are opened one by one for 1 hour alternately, then in what time will the tank be filled in hours, rounded to the nearest integer?
questions.questionHtml: Two inlets P and Q are connected to a tank. P and Q can fill the tank in 24 hours and 36 hours respectively. If both the pipes, starting with P, are opened one by one for 1 hour alternately, then in what time will the tank be filled in hours, rounded to the nearest integer?
questions.solution:
P fills tank in 24 hours
Q fills tank in 36 hours

LCM of 24 and 36 = 72

So, total work = 72 units

P’s 1-hour work = 72/24 = 3 units
Q’s 1-hour work = 72/36 = 2 units

In 2 hours, P + Q fill:

3 + 2 = 5 units

In 28 hours = 14 cycles

Work done = 14 × 5 = 70 units

Remaining work = 72 - 70 = 2 units

Next turn is P.

P fills 3 units in 1 hour, so time for 2 units:

2/3 hour

Total time = 28 + 2/3 = 28.67 hours

Nearest integer = 29 hours

Answer: 29 hours

questions.question: A rhombus has all sides equal to 13 cm and one diagonal is 10 cm. What is the length of the other diagonal?
questions.questionHtml: A rhombus has all sides equal to 13 cm and one diagonal is 10 cm. What is the length of the other diagonal?
questions.solution:
In a rhombus, diagonals bisect at 90°.

Side = 13 cm
One diagonal = 10 cm

Half diagonal = 5 cm

Now use Pythagorean triplet:

5, 12, 13

So, half of other diagonal = 12 cm

Other diagonal = 12 × 2 = 24 cm
